title: Onboard aurora-pro-13b v1.2: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Priya Shah
description: Onboard aurora-pro-13b v1.2 into the model registry with updated metadata, production performance profiles, and an enhancement to the changelog-generation automation so model version bumps include structured release notes. Motivation: customers have requested the aurora-pro family on Dedicated and Private with predictable latency/cost profiles; v1.2 includes a tokenizer fix and quantization-friendly checkpoint. This PR adds a model card, perf profiles for common CPU/GPU families, test vectors, and a small change to the changelog generator so onboarding events emit a structured entry (model, version, perf-summary) into the release notes pipeline. Checklist: - [x] Add model metadata (card, tags, licenses) - [x] Generate performance profiles (latency/throughput across target instance types) - [x] Add unit + integration tests for registry ingestion - [x] Update docs with usage examples and known limitations - [x] Wire changelog automation to include model onboarding entries - [x] Smoke test registry sync to hosted catalog Notes: perf numbers are based on standardized harness runs (perf-canary/benchmarks) and include quantized and fp16 profiles. The changelog automation change is backward-compatible; it adds a new structured section when model metadata contains "release_notes_hint". See linked Linear tickets for follow-up tasks (rollout gating for Dedicated pools and additional region profiling).
